name: risk-gate
description: Assess whether an operation is destructive or risky before executing. Gates dangerous actions with a probability score.

question.instructions: Is this operation destructive, hard to reverse, or could it cause data loss? Consider: file deletion, git force-push, database drops, production deployments, overwriting uncommitted work.
If this operation goes wrong, how many people or systems are affected?
Can this operation be easily undone? Consider: git reset, restoring from backup, re-running a build. Force-pushes, dropped tables, and sent messages are not easily reversible.
